items.followUp: Compare the shape and usual location of cuboidal and columnar epithelial cells.

rubric.why: Identifies the characteristic shape of cuboidal epithelial cells.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for describing the cells as cube-shaped or cubical.

rubric.why: Distinguishes the shape of columnar epithelial cells from that of cuboidal cells.
rubric.description: Columnar epithelial cells are tall and column-shaped, with their height greater than their width.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for describing the cells as tall or column-shaped, or stating that their height is greater than their width.

modelAnswer: Cuboidal epithelial cells are cube-shaped, with their height and width approximately equal.
Columnar epithelial cells are tall and column-shaped, with their height greater than their width.
